messages:
alice: heads up — customer (dave@acme) reports 401s in Next.js SSR after upgrading @redwood/inference-sdk to 2.1.0. Works locally but fails when deployed to Vercel edge. Repro steps below. @carol can you triage?

dave: seeing repeated 401s in prod only. curl to hosted API with same key works. stack shows 'Missing API key' coming from our auth layer. No obvious errors locally.

ben: can you paste package.json + exports map and the prod build logs? my hunch: bundler/resolver is picking wrong entry (cjs vs esm) and edge runtime path is missing the fetch shim that attaches auth.

alice: here's the minimal package.json from the app that reproduces:
```json
{
  "name": "acme-next-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood/inference-sdk": "^2.1.0"
  },
  "type": "module"
}
```

alice: and the installed package manifest (from node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk/package.json):
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference-sdk",
  "version": "2.1.0",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
    }
  }
}
```

alice: build log (vercel/edge) shows resolution to CJS entry and then runtime error:
```
edge-worker: Error: Missing API key
    at attachAuth (/workspace/.vercel/output/functions/edge/index.js:45:12)
    at processRequest (/workspace/.vercel/output/functions/edge/index.js:78:5)
```

dave: also pasted a snippet from our serverless build output where the bundler warns: `Module not found: Can't resolve 'node:stream'` and then polyfills are injected and cjs entry ends up used.

carol: thanks — this looks like an exports/entry selection edge case with Next/Vercel where the bundler (or esbuild step) resolves to the CJS build for SSR bundles in the edge output. The CJS build relies on a runtime shim that isn't included in the edge bundle, so auth attachment doesn't run. two mitigation paths: pin back to 2.0.x (works) or patch package publishing so the ESM entry is unambiguous and the edge build picks it.

carol: quick suggested workaround for customers: in next.config.js add:
```js
module.exports = {
  webpack: (config) => {
    config.resolve.mainFields = ['module', 'main'];
    return config;
  }
};
```

ben: alternative runtime workaround: set VERCEL_BUILD_OUTPUT=server to avoid esbuild bundling edge output, but that's not ideal.

alice: customer tried the webpack tweak and confirmed it fixed the issue in a staging deploy. they reported immediate auth success.

carol: long-term fix: update our publish script to include an explicit top-level `exports` mapping and a small `package.json` sentinel for edge bundlers. Example change we plan:
```diff
- "main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
- "module": "dist/index.mjs",
+ "exports": {
+   ".": {
+     "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
+     "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
+   },
+   "./package.json": "./package.json"
+ },
+ "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
+ "files": ["dist"]
```
This makes resolution explicit and prevents some bundlers from picking the wrong entry. We'll also ensure the published tarball contains both dist/*.mjs and dist/*.cjs files and that the ESM build includes the edge auth shim.

ben: mitigation plan for support: recommend pinning to `@redwood/inference-sdk@2.0.3` until patch shipped. please capture customer consent to pin.

dave: confirmed — we'll pin to 2.0.3 for now. thanks. :pray:

carol: opening PR to adjust publish + add an integration test that publishes a package locally and builds a tiny Next app to assert resolution. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432 (WIP).

ben: assigning to eng-devex and eng-runtime to verify the edge shim inclusion. also adding a release candidate patch 2.1.1 to cut once tests pass.

alice: logging notes and customer comms: told customer to pin and that we're working on patch. will update when PR merged and we cut a patch.

support-bot: Status update: mitigation=pin v2.0.3, fix_in_progress=eng-devex/PR-432, notify_on_release=yes :white_check_mark:

carol: added unit to the release checklist to ensure `exports` plays well with Next/Vercel/ESBuild. will follow up in the PR with CI artifacts.

ben: thanks all. closing thread once patch is released.
